requests_made.purpose: retrieve the full public programme listing (no pagination indicator found live — a single fetch returned all 26 current/upcoming programme items across every discipline)
requests_made.retained_fixture: fixtures/galeria-ze-dos-bois/programme-excerpt.html (bounded excerpt: 6 of 26 live entries, selected to exercise area/category music filtering across Exhibitions/Workshops/Theater/Concerts and both off-site and own-building venue text)

findings.pagination: None found live — a single fetch is genuinely complete.
findings.stable_identifier: No numeric id is exposed anywhere on this listing; every item's own permalink slug (/en/programa/{slug}/) is used as source_record_id.
findings.date_time: Every live 'Music'/'Concerts' entry carries a genuine 'DD.MM.YY' day plus a 12-hour time (e.g. '09.09.2609:30PM'). This venue's own non-music Exhibitions/Workshops entries instead carry a plain multi-day range whose own leading portion omits its own year (e.g. '23.05 — 26.09.26') — this collector deliberately does not derive a date from that shape (fails closed, TEXT_ONLY), since no live music entry has ever used it.
findings.music_filtering: This venue's own first-party `area`/`categorias` taxonomy (area="Music" AND category="Concerts") is the one deterministic filter applied — genuinely excludes this same venue's own Visual Arts/Exhibitions, Learning/Workshops, and Performing Arts/Theater programming (all real, live entries).
findings.venue_identity: This is a genuinely multi-location listing: most entries' own `local` text is 'Galeria Zé dos Bois' (this venue's own main building, already canonical), but a handful are off-site (e.g. 'Igreja St. George', 'LAV - Lisboa Ao Vivo', 'ZDB 8 MARVILA'). Only the exact string 'Galeria Zé dos Bois' resolves, via a new data-driven mapping entry (venues/source-venue-mappings.json); every other exact string is deliberately left unmapped rather than guessed at.
